text: In World War Two, the US military strapped tiny firebombs to bats. Then the bats set fire to the US military. Bats like to roost under roofs. So the plan was to drop thousands of them in a bomb casing, each carrying a small timed incendiary, and let them crawl into buildings before it went off. During a test in New Mexico, some armed bats got loose. They roosted under a fuel tank and set the airfield on fire. Including a general's car. The project kept going, spent about two million dollars, and was cancelled because it would not be ready in time. Dave parked right next to the general.
